District 6

District 6 takes in Whitehaven and neighborhoods across Southwest Memphis. The district lists 26 schools in it, from elementary through high school.

Each school below links to its own official website. For meetings, agendas and public comment, see The Board.

Find your school

Attendance zones are set by the district, not by this office. Use the district's own tools to find the school for an address.
